messages:
rachel-sales: Hey team, Hearthbank POC kicks off next Mon. They're asking for a concise Private/VPC connectivity checklist (firewall rules, SNI expectations, IPs we need whitelisted) + POC pricing for PrivateLink. cc @elaine @raj
elaine: Quick q — will they use an AWS interface endpoint (PrivateLink) in their VPC or route through a transit/VPN TGW into a spoke? changes the SNAT behavior.
rachel-sales: They plan VPN -> spoke VPC -> interface endpoint to our endpoint service. On-prem will be behind a perimeter proxy. They also want to know if we require preserved client source IPs.
raj: If they use an interface endpoint, traffic terminates in their VPC to our NLB/ENIs and source IPs are preserved (no SNAT) assuming no proxy in between. If their perimeter proxy SNATs, we only see proxy IPs. Recommend they allow TLS passthrough (SNI) and outbound TCP/443 to our endpoint EIPs. Also note IPSec MTU tuning (set tunnel MTU ~1400) to avoid fragmentation.
tom-netops: Minimal ACL example: allow outbound tcp/443 to our endpoint CIDR 10.10.55.0/27 (region-specific EIPs) and to public NLB EIPs we provide. If they use TGW+NAT, also allow ephemeral return ports (1024-65535). Will provide exact IP list after we confirm region.
raj: Short iptables snippet for customers who run an egress proxy (example — only if they SNAT):
```
# if proxy SNATs traffic to our endpoint IPs
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE
```
sasha-security: For security reviewers: we currently support client TLS with SNI. Mutual TLS (mTLS) is available for Dedicated/private deployments but requires a security addendum and ~48–72h to configure certs and rotation. Also we can provide cert chains and CRL/OCSP info for auditing.
raj: Pricing / capacity note: for short POCs we suggest Dedicated capacity reservation to keep predictable latency. POC discount can be applied — sales ops will add to the quote. EIP costs for interface endpoints (if customer owns EIPs or we provide NAT EIPs) are billed to the customer.
rachel-sales: Customer asks about logging/observability — they want connection logs and 90d retention. Can we push to their S3?
elaine: Yes — we can deliver access logs to customer S3 using cross-account role. For VPC flow logs they should enable flow logs in their account and share the bucket. We'll include a SOC packet with certs, logs schema, and retention options.
deploy-bot: Deployment plan queued: private-endpoint-handoff Fri 13:00 UTC. Running automated preflight checks: port 443 reachability, SNI match, cert validation.
raj: I'll draft a one-page handoff with: exact EIP list per region, minimal ACLs, example iptables/proxy snippets, MTU note, and a short troubleshooting checklist (SNI mismatch, proxied SNAT, DNS resolving interface endpoint vs public). ETA EOD today.
rachel-sales: :thumbsup: Thanks. @sasha-security can you confirm mTLS paperwork requirements so I can answer the customer's security questionnaire?
sasha-security: mTLS requires a compliance addendum and additional provisioning steps (CA exchange + rotation). Send me the customer org name and expected concurrency and I'll open the request.
rachel-sales: Sending org: hearthbank-inc (will DM sales case id). Team — please drop any additional notes into the POC playbook confluence page, I'll run the handoff once raj posts the IP list.
